title: Early Prediction of Progression to Alzheimer's Disease using Multi-Modality Neuroimages by a Novel Ordinal Learning Model ADPacer.
summary: ADPacer predicts progression from mild cognitive impairment to Alzheimer’s disease using multimodal neuroimaging with an ordinal-learning model.
ai_technology: Longitudinal imaging cohorts and held-out evaluation compare progression prediction against baseline methods.
organization: H. Hilton Stewart School of Industrial and Systems Engineering

evidence.tested: ADPacer predicts progression from mild cognitive impairment to Alzheimer’s disease using multimodal neuroimaging with an ordinal-learning model.
evidence.unknown: Retrospective cohort prediction is limited to the tested populations and does not establish prevention or treatment effects.
evidence.ai_role: Longitudinal imaging cohorts and held-out evaluation compare progression prediction against baseline methods.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
